findings.title: Scheduler re-selects a granted slot during the one-cycle dequeue window (confirmed at source)
findings.detail: CONFIRMED BY SOURCE INSPECTION, cycle-accurate: scheduler.sv's FR-FCFS selection is purely combinational over q_valid and carries no mask for the slot granted on the previous cycle; deq_grant is registered (one-cycle pulse), and cmd_queue.sv clears mem_valid[deq_idx] one cycle after the grant. During that cycle the still-valid slot is re-selected, issuing every CAS twice (observed: 29 grants for 19 enqueues; duplicate WR/RD flagged as SCHED_002 by the invariant checker). The ACT path is worse: bank state feedback routes through cmd_gen's REGISTERED fb pulses, so is_act_needed lags selection by two cycles and the scheduler repeats ACTIVATE to the same bank without PRECHARGE (PROTO_002). Fix is internal to the scheduler: mask the just-granted slot (and in-flight ACT targets) from selection, or make the dequeue clear same-cycle. Independently corroborated by wb_port's own embedded assertions (p_tag, p_stall_hold) firing in the same runs.

source_refs: scheduler.sv: always_comb selection over q_valid, no granted-slot mask
scheduler.sv: deq_grant <= 1'b1 registered, defaulted 0 each cycle
cmd_queue.sv: if (deq_grant && mem_valid[deq_idx]) mem_valid[deq_idx] <= 1'b0  (one cycle later)
